dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregularly oval outer perimeters with sharp high-contrast transitions from a light-grey interior band to a deep-blue/black exterior field; prominently visible as a cluster of four closed 'O' shapes on the upper mid-dorsal ridge and two semi-closed 'C' shapes on the lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of solid, non-gradient white pixel clusters localized at the anterior lateral region near the head and neck, transitioning to a lower density of isolated, smaller high-intensity spots toward the mid-section and caudal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent dorsal annuli form an obtuse triangle configuration. A secondary linear relationship is formed by three high-intensity blobs positioned in a chain along the lower neck, oriented at approximately 30 degrees relative to the primary dorsal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Single high-contrast circular point of high intensity located at the ocular position on the anterior head region, distinct from the surrounding fur texture.
